$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：紫微天相坐辰戌，《深造講義》p.163。

basis.quote: 使需要要分别其为有情，抑或无情

rules.text: 紫微在辰戌最弱：紫相坐命，容易太過急功近利，不作長遠考慮，只圖眼前利益。
rules.en: Zi Wei is weakest in Chen and Xu: with Zi Wei–Tian Xiang in the Life Palace, you can be too eager for quick results, not thinking long-term, only about immediate gain.
rules.edit: 原句「招無情無義之譏」不用；「人生必有缺憾」一句涉婚姻子女病患，不入讀者句。

rules.text: 會照的武曲化祿，令你有情，這是對紫相最有利的。
rules.en: Wu Qu transformed by Lu in your trine makes you warm-hearted, the most favourable case for Zi Wei–Tian Xiang.

rules.text: 會照的廉貞化祿，令你感情較豐富。
rules.en: Lian Zhen transformed by Lu in your trine makes you richer in feeling.

source.quote: 便使[紫相]亦稍为感情丰富

rules.text: 對面遷移宮的破軍化祿，只增加事業的聲勢，不令你更有情。
rules.en: Po Jun opposite you is transformed by Lu, which adds momentum to your career without making you warmer.

source.quote: 则仅增加人生事业的声势

rules.text: 決絕的一面較重；但這份無情往往不是主動的：付出感情得不到回報，才會心死，斷然了結一段關係。無情不等於薄情。
rules.en: The decisive, unsentimental side is stronger; but it's rarely where you start: when feeling given gets nothing back, your heart closes and you end things cleanly. Unsentimental isn't the same as cold.

source.quote: 所以无情并非一定等于薄情

rules.text: 會照的廉貞化忌，令你決絕，根源是自卑。
rules.en: Lian Zhen transformed by Ji in your trine makes you cut ties more readily, rooted in a sense of inferiority.

source.quote: 廉贞化忌者的无情出于自卑戚

rules.text: 會照的武曲化忌，令你決絕，根源是利益衝突。
rules.en: Wu Qu transformed by Ji in your trine makes you cut ties more readily, rooted in clashes of interest.

source.quote: 武曲化忌者的无情则出于利益的冲突
